title: Rewinding the work tape
statement: Let $x$ and $w$ be Boolean words and let $i$ be a valid input-head position for input $x$. For every integer $r$ with $r\le |w|$, starting in the appender's work-rewind state with input head at $i$, work tape holding $w$, and work head at $r-1$, after exactly $r+1$ steps the machine is in its input-rewind state with input head still at $i$, work tape still holding $w$, and work head at zero.
hypotheses_covered: initial state is the work-rewind state
replaced:
For every $r \le |w|$: from the rewind state with the work head at offset
$r - 1$ over a tape holding $w$, exactly $r + 1$ steps return the head to the
origin and enter the input-rewind state; the blank at offset $-1$ is used only
locally and never written.
